【原视频简介】
Support Me On Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/theartofstorytelling

Thanks to the Centre For AI Safety for funding this video. Check them out at: https://safe.ai/

As more stories emerge about the threats posed by Artificial Intelligence, I thought it would be fun to revisit the classics and science fiction and see how this technology has been anticipated by the authors/filmmakers of the past. 

Minor correction: In "The Matrix", it's the humans who blot the sun, not the machines. 

#storytelling #sciencefiction
metadata.title: 科幻作品如何预言人工智能的威胁｜Sci-Fi Was Right About AI
